'''Line officer''' was a type of military [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Military rank/Legends|rank]]. In contrast to [[staff officer]]s, who received their commission based on a specific area of expertise, line officers commanded [[Troop/Legends|troop]]s in the field.<ref name="GaW" />
